propositions: Module refactoring (RP-02 S2 T2) moved absence/tombstone/comment operations (clear_absent and siblings) from binding_store to binding_lifecycle, but the integration idempotency test only patches _now_iso on binding_store, narrowing its regression-detection reach.
The idempotency oracle no longer reaches clock reads in clear_absent and moved sibling operations because they resolve _now_iso from binding_lifecycle module, not the patched binding_store module.

Patching _now_iso on both binding_store and binding_lifecycle modules restores the integration test's ability to detect regressions that cause binding operations to unconditionally stamp updated_at timestamps on unchanged passes.

clear_absent is structurally unreachable on healthy in-window reconcile passes, rendering seeded mutation testing of its timestamp behavior infeasible at the integration tier; the unit tier test (test_binding_lifecycle.py::test_clear_absent_does_not_dirty_an_entry_with_no_absence) provides the primary contract coverage.
